semantics.weight: nonnegative rational; denominator positive; sum exactly one
semantics.event: declared subset of one artifact's finite worlds
semantics.conjunction: intersection in one artifact; no independence assumption
semantics.adoption: P0 explicit revision and separate human confirmation at the same view
semantics.unknown_capability: any visible report in the context blocks interpretation
semantics.conflict: any adopted positive/negative report pair in the context blocks answers
semantics.output: reduced rational with artifact, model, interval and ledger evidence
semantics.clinical_conversion: no operation or rule produces clinical assertions

steps: one for each world weight added, then one for normalization comparison, per artifact in ref order
one per assertion and review before selecting each view in id order
one at each query start in id order within each view
one for every world/event membership pair, including zero-weight worlds, without short circuit
one for each selected world weight added
one before committing each computed answer
validation_order: JSON and structural/reference/hash/rational validation before steps; exact weight normalization before views
budget_stop: retain completed queries; all unfinished queries unassessed with null answer; no partial probability
hashes: native spec raw SHA-256 pinned in handler; artifact SHA-256 over canonical JSON, UTF-8, sorted keys, compact separators, ensure_ascii=false
